source_evidence: The participation rate determines how much of the gain in the index will be credited to your annuity.
answer: A participation rate sets the share of an index gain that is credited to an indexed annuity. For example, with a 75% participation rate and a 10% index return during the measuring period, the annuity would be credited with a 7.5% return. The participation rate applies to the index return; it does not mean the annuity receives the full gain.
